user.title: Connect to your Managed Switch
user.description: Works with HORACO HC-SWTGW218AS, HC-SWTGW215AS, ZX-SWTG124AS, keepLink KP9000 and compatible OEM switches. Default credentials are admin / admin.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the switch, 10 to 300 seconds. Lower values react faster but load the switch's small web server harder; 30 seconds is a good default. You can change this later without re-adding the switch.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the switch. Check the IP address and credentials.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the switch, 10 to 300 seconds. Changes apply immediately — no restart needed.
